fields.label: Last Name
fields.description: Family name / surname of the professional.

fields.label: Full Name
fields.description: Full display name of the professional (first and last name together).

fields.label: Email
fields.description: Primary email address of the professional.

fields.label: Phone
fields.description: Primary phone number for the professional.

fields.label: Title
fields.description: Job title or professional role of the person (e.g. Senior Loan Officer).

fields.label: Company
fields.description: Organization, brokerage, agency or employer the professional works for.

fields.label: Website
fields.description: Personal or business website URL of the professional (not a social network profile).

fields.label: LinkedIn
fields.description: LinkedIn profile URL of the professional.

fields.label: Address
fields.description: Street address of the professional's office (street line only, without city/state/zip).

fields.label: City
fields.description: City of the professional's office address.

fields.label: State
fields.description: State or region of the professional's office address (2-letter code preferred).

fields.label: ZIP Code
fields.description: Postal / ZIP code of the professional's office address.

fields.label: Bio
fields.description: Professional biography describing the person's background and experience.

fields.label: Specialties
fields.description: Areas of expertise, products or services the professional specializes in.

fields.label: Service Area
fields.description: Geographic areas (cities, counties, regions) the professional serves.

fields.label: Years of Experience
fields.description: Number of years of professional experience, as a whole number.

fields.label: License Number
fields.description: Professional license number issued by a regulator.

fields.label: Profile Image
fields.description: URL of the professional's profile photo / headshot.
